recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下為瀰漫成片、單一形態的小至中型淋巴樣細胞，核形不規則、有摺痕，夾雜細小血管，屬於侵襲性淋巴瘤浸潤；本視野未見腺體。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, folded to angulated nuclei with moderately dense chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale cytoplasm with occasional clear spaces between cells
Scattered small capillaries with red cells; no residual glands in this field
No prominent necrosis visible in this field
describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, folded nuclear contours, moderately dense chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm, traversed by small capillaries. Residual glands are not present in this field, and necrosis is not evident here. The morphology indicates a lymphoma; with the accompanying CD3+, CD56+, CD4-/CD5-/CD8- and EBER+ immunoprofile, the findings are consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and express CD20/PAX5 rather than CD3/CD56.
PTCL-NOS can look identical on H&E but is typically CD56 negative and EBER negative.
Lymphoblasts have fine blastic chromatin with frequent mitoses and express TdT and CD34/CD99.
Carcinoma shows cohesive nests and cytokeratin positivity, unlike this discohesive lymphoid sheet.
